item.tib: khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las mchod skong ud dpal spungs mdzes
item.coloph: zhes mchod skong ud dpal spungs mdzes zhes bya ba 'di ni khro mchog 'dus pa sde brgyad 'byung po spyi 'dul gyi rgyud las kho bo phyogs med kyi rnal 'byor ba gtsug phud rnam rgyal du 'bod pa bdag gis bsdus shing bsgrigs pa 'dis kyang sngags kyi phrin las rgyas par gyur cig/
